Home.aiDoes1: Organizes your request so the right dāʿī sees it.
Home.aiDoes2: Suggests reading from approved sources, always with the citation.

Home.aiNever2: Guesses your beliefs or labels you.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.intro: What we keep, who can see it, and for how long.
Privacy.askBody: Only a pseudonym. You can add a short note about yourself; it's optional, and only the dāʿīs who talk with you see it. No email, no phone number.
Privacy.codeBody: Your return code brings you back to your conversations from any device. We store only a protected fingerprint of it (a salted hash), never the code itself, so it can't be shown again. At the end of a conversation you can ask for a new code; the old one stops working at once.
Privacy.cardsBody: A Wasl card is a short summary you write so whoever continues with you can pick up where you left off.
Privacy.cardsSelect: It's built only from the messages you choose. Anything you leave empty is saved as “not specified”, never guessed.
Privacy.cardsWho: Nothing is shared until you approve it. You choose who sees it: the dāʿī you're talking to, the team, or only the next dāʿī.
Privacy.cardsHowLong: It stays until you delete it, or for 7, 14 or 30 days if you choose.
Privacy.cardsDelete: You can delete it at any time from the card page. Every version is removed, and no dāʿī can see it from that moment.
Privacy.cardsInactive: Cards with no activity for 12 months are removed automatically.
Privacy.conversationsBody: Your messages are seen by you and the dāʿī you talk with, and by a colleague if your conversation is handed over. Administrators never read conversations; they see only counts and averages.
Privacy.aiBody: When the organization turns it on, an AI guide can organize your request, suggest reading from approved sources with their citations, and draft a card that you edit and approve. It never gives a fatwa (a religious ruling) or answers religious questions, never guesses your beliefs, and shares nothing without your approval. Wasl works fully without it.
